answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a refundable bond before it may issue claims or earn rewards. A Sybil attacker must lock real capital for every persona, while honest agents recover their bonds after sustained, non-abusive participation; one identity’s proven fraud can also forfeit its bond. This does not make identities impossible to fake, but makes influence costly: ivory, velvet, or ember personas all need separately funded stakes, and splitting activity no longer comes free.
